full_text: Conversation. Kat 3 months ago. Would you mind if I place our conversation on a brief hold while I conduct this review? I'll return promptly once I've finished. No problem take your time. We really appreciate you waiting as we tried to sort this out. This might take a little longer, but I'm dedicated to finding a solution for you. Please allow me another 1-2 minutes to continue working on it. Thank you. Thank you for your patience, I am so sorry to keep you waiting. As much as I really want to help you with this, but since this is outside of my scope, I have taken note of your concern and will not hold you any much longer. I will have to send you over our specialized team so you'll be assisted accordingly.
